fields.name: item_num
fields.coerce: none: used as an array key, so `"4"` also works. Any other value reads an empty slot
fields.description: The slot of an item that you can exchange (`G.items[name].e`).

responses.name: Started
responses.when: All checks pass. The server removes `G.items[name].e` units of the item, puts a placeholder in the first empty slot and starts the timer.

fields.name: success
fields.description: Always `false`: the result comes when the timer ends.

fields.name: num
fields.description: The slot of the placeholder `{name: "placeholder"}`. This placeholder has no `p`.

responses.name: Log
responses.when: The timer ends. One line for each result of the roll: an item (`server.item.received`, or `fished`, `mined`, `glitched`), gold (`server.game_log.received_gold`), shells (`server.shells.received`), or nothing (`server.game_log.didn_t_receive_anything`). A cosmetic sends no line.

responses.name: Cosmetic
responses.when: The timer ends and the roll gives a cosmetic (`cx`) or a cosmetic bundle (`cxbundle`).

fields.name: acx
fields.description: All your cosmetics now: name to count (`player.p.acx`).

fields.name: name
fields.description: The cosmetic or the bundle that you got.

responses.name: Quest done
responses.when: The timer ends, after the results, when the item has a `quest` (for example `seashell`, `leather`, `gemfragment`, `lostearring`, or `cx` for `cosmo*`).

fields.name: suffix
fields.description: The level of an upgrade or compound item (for example `lostearring`), else `""`. A level of 0 also gives `""`: the server stores the level only when it is truthy (node/server.js:6670-6672) and sends `ref.s || ""`.

rows.when: The character is in the bank.
No empty inventory slot (`esize <= 0`), and the item is a stack with `q` above 1.
The item has no `e`, or there is no drop table `D.drops[id]`. `id` is the item name, plus the level for an upgrade or compound item (for example `lostearring2`).
You are more than `B.sell_dist` (400 px) from the NPC: the quest NPC of the item (`G.quests[quest]`), else the exchange NPC on `main`. A character with a `computer` passes this check.
`e` is above 1, and the stack has fewer than `e` units.

confirm.note: `item.q < def.e` is false when the item has no `q`

also.name: Placeholder
also.summary: Your state with `reopen: true`. The slot `num` holds `{name: "placeholder"}`, and `q.exchange` is an `QDataExchange`.

also.name: Gold
also.when: The timer ends and the roll gives more than 3,000,000 gold, unless you are `stealth`.

also.name: Item
also.when: The timer ends and the roll gives a rare item, or the item got `p: "shiny"` (the exchange rolls for shiny: 1/500 for an upgrade item, 1/20,000 for a compound item).

example.message: Wizard received a Shiny Candy Cane
example.name: Wizard

also.when: The timer ends and the roll gives shells. Not on `hardcore` or `test` servers.
also.summary: `{message: "+<amount>", x, y, id, args: {c, s: "cash", sz: "huge"}}` over your character.

also.when: The timer ends, for an item without a `quest`. Every client whose view holds the exchange NPC on `main`.

also.name: Done
also.when: The timer ends, last. The placeholder slot is empty again (or holds a result item), and `q.exchange` is gone.

order: now: `player` (placeholder in a slot, `q.exchange` set) to you

at the end, for each result of the roll: `server_message` to everyone (rare item or more than 3,000,000 gold), `game_log` to you, `cx_new` to you for a cosmetic. A drop table can roll another table (`open`), and its `_bonus` table can add more results
then `game_response` `<quest>_success` to you (quest items), or `upgrade` to clients near the exchange NPC
